H1081.name: Baladan
H1081.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1081.short: Baladan was the father of Merodach-baladan, king of Babylon.

H1071G.name: Becher
H1071G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1071G.brief: Son of Benjamin, listed among those who entered Egypt.
H1071G.short: Becher was a son of Benjamin and is listed among the family members who entered Egypt with Jacob.

H1071H.name: Becher
H1071H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1071H.brief: An Ephraimite clan head in the wilderness census.
H1071H.short: The Becherites, descendants of Becher, were a clan of the tribe of Ephraim during the wilderness census.

H1064.name: Becorath
H1064.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H1064.brief: An ancestor of King Saul from the tribe of Benjamin.
H1064.short: Becorath was an ancestor of King Saul and a member of the tribe of Benjamin.

H1051.name: Beth-rapha
H1051.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1051.short: Beth-rapha was a descendant of Judah through Eshton.

H1075.name: Bichri
H1075.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H1075.brief: Benjamite, father of the rebel Sheba
H1075.short: Bichri, a Benjamite, was the father of Sheba, who led a rebellion against King David.

H1085.name: Bildad
H1085.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1085.short: Bildad the Shuhite was one of Job's three friends who came to comfort him during his affliction.

H1083G.name: Bilgah
H1083G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1083G.brief: Head of a priestly division in David's time
H1083G.short: Bilgah was the head of the fifteenth division of priests during David's reign.

H1083H.name: Bilgah
H1083H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1083H.brief: Priest who returned from exile and sealed the covenant
H1083H.short: Bilgah, also known as Bilgai, was a priest who returned from Babylonian exile and sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H1090A.name: Bilhah
H1090A.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1090A.brief: Rachel's maidservant and mother of Dan and Naphtali
H1090A.short: Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant, bore Jacob two sons, Dan and Naphtali, who became ancestors of Israelite tribes.

H1092H.name: Bilhan
H1092H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1092H.brief: Benjamite, son of Jediael and father of seven sons
H1092H.short: Bilhan, a Benjamite, was the son of Jediael and had seven sons who were heads of families.

H1092G.name: Bilhan
H1092G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1092G.brief: Descendant of Esau and chief of Edom
H1092G.short: Bilhan, a descendant of Esau, was one of the chiefs of Edom.

H1074.name: Bocheru
H1074.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1074.brief: Son of Azel, a descendant of King Saul
H1074.short: Bocheru was a son of Azel and a descendant of King Saul from the tribe of Benjamin.

H1006.name: Bajith
H1006.brief: Moabite temple or high place mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy.
H1006.short: Bajith (or "temple") was a Moabite temple or high place mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy against Moab. (<ref="Isaiah 15:2">Isaiah 15:2</ref>)

H1088.name: Balah
H1088.brief: Town allotted to the tribe of Simeon.
H1088.short: Balah was a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon. (<ref="Joshua 19:3">Joshua 19:3</ref>)

H1043.name: Beth-anath
H1043.brief: Canaanite town allotted to Naphtali, but not fully conquered.
H1043.short: Beth-anath was a Canaanite town allotted to the tribe of Naphtali, but the Naphtalites did not drive out its inhabitants.

H1042.name: Beth-anoth
H1042.brief: Town in the hill country of Judah.
H1042.short: Beth-anoth was a town in the hill country of Judah, mentioned in the list of cities and villages within Judah's inheritance. (<ref="Joshua 15:59">Joshua 15:59</ref>)

H1026.name: Beth-arabah
H1026.brief: Town and wilderness area in Judah, also associated with Benjamin.
H1026.short: Beth-arabah was a town and wilderness area allotted to Judah and Benjamin, and the Arbathite was a descendant of Abi-albon.
H1026.meaning: “house of the desert valley” or “place of the depression”

forms.meaning: “house of the desert valley” or “place of the depression”

H1009.name: Beth-arbel
H1009.brief: Place destroyed by Shalman, mentioned in Hosea's prophecy.
H1009.short: Beth-arbel was a place destroyed by Shalman, mentioned in Hosea's prophecy as an example of destruction. (<ref="Hosea 10:14">Hosea 10:14</ref>)

H1004G.name: Beth-ashbea
H1004G.brief: Place associated with the families of the house of Ashbea.
H1004G.short: Beth-ashbea was a place associated with the families of the house of Ashbea, who were known for their fine linen work. (<ref="1Ch.4.21">1Ch.4.21</ref>)

H1045.name: Beth-Ashtoreth
H1045.brief: Philistine city where Saul's armor was put in a temple.
H1045.short: Beth-Ashtoreth was a Philistine city where Saul's armor was put in the temple of Ashtoreth after his death. (<ref="1Sa.31.10">1Sa.31.10</ref>)

H1007.name: Beth-aven
H1007.brief: Town and wilderness near Ai and Bethel.
H1007.short: Beth-aven was a town and wilderness near Ai and Bethel, associated with idolatry and Israel's defeat.

H1041.name: Beth-azmaveth
H1041.brief: Town of Benjamin, home to some who returned from exile.
H1041.short: Beth-azmaveth (Azmaveth) was a town in Benjamin, home to some who returned from the Babylonian exile.

H1012.name: Beth-barah
H1012.brief: Place where Gideon stationed men to intercept the Midianites.
H1012.short: Beth-barah (Bethabara) was a place where Gideon stationed men to intercept the fleeing Midianites, and where John the Baptist baptized.

H1011.name: Beth-biri
H1011.brief: Town in Simeon, formerly called Bethul.
H1011.short: Beth-biri was a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon, formerly known as Bethul. (<ref="1Ch.4.31">1Ch.4.31</ref>)

H1033.name: Beth-car
H1033.brief: Place where the Israelites pursued the Philistines.
H1033.short: Beth-car was the place where the Israelites pursued the Philistines after the return of the Ark of the Covenant. (<ref="1Sa.7.11">1Sa.7.11</ref>)
H1033.meaning: “house of the ram” or “place of the lamb”

forms.meaning: “house of the ram” or “place of the lamb”

H1016G.name: Beth-dagon
H1016G.brief: Town in Judah, named after the Philistine god Dagon.
H1016G.short: Beth-dagon was a town in Judah, likely named after the Philistine god Dagon. (<ref="Joshua 15:41">Joshua 15:41</ref>)

H1016H.name: Beth-dagon
H1016H.brief: Town in Asher, named after the Philistine god Dagon.
H1016H.short: Beth-dagon was a town in the territory of Asher, likely named after the Philistine god Dagon. (<ref="Joshua 19:27">Joshua 19:27</ref>)

H1040.name: Beth-eden
H1040.brief: Place associated with the rulers of Aram (Syria).
H1040.short: Beth-eden was a place associated with the rulers of Aram (Syria), mentioned in Amos's prophecy against Damascus. (<ref="Amo.1.5">Amo.1.5</ref>)

H1044.name: Beth-eked
H1044.brief: Place where Jehu killed the brothers of Ahaziah.
H1044.short: Beth-eked was a place where Jehu killed the forty-two brothers of Ahaziah, king of Judah. (<ref="2Ki.10.12, 14">2Ki.10.12, 14</ref>)

H1008G.name: Bethel
H1008G.brief: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.
H1008G.short: Bethel, also called Luz, was an important city in Israel, associated with the patriarchs Abraham and Jacob, later becoming a center of idolatry. (Multiple references, see article for details)

forms.meaning: “The God of the House of God”

H1008H.name: Bethel
H1008H.brief: Town in Judah that received spoils from David's victory.
H1008H.short: Bethel was a town in Judah that received spoils from David's victory over the Amalekites. (<ref="1Sa.30.27">1Sa.30.27</ref>)

forms.meaning: “God destroys” or “man of God” or “dweller in God”
“God destroys” or “man of God” or “dweller in God”

H1025.name: Beth-emek
H1025.brief: Town in Asher's territory, near the border.
H1025.short: Beth-emek was a town in the territory of Asher, mentioned in the description of Asher's border. (<ref="Joshua 19:27">Joshua 19:27</ref>)

H1018.name: Beth-ezel
H1018.brief: Town mentioned in Micah's prophecy, possibly near Jerusalem.
H1018.short: Beth-ezel was a town mentioned in Micah's prophecy, where the inhabitants could not offer support or refuge during a time of judgment. (<ref="Micah 1:11">Micah 1:11</ref>)

H1013.name: Beth-gader
H1013.brief: Town associated with the descendants of Hareph.
H1013.short: Beth-gader was a town associated with the descendants of Hareph, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah. (<ref="1Ch.2.51">1Ch.2.51</ref>)

H1014.name: Beth-gamul
H1014.brief: Moabite town mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy against Moab.
H1014.short: Beth-gamul was a Moabite town mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy against Moab, likely destroyed or captured by the Babylonians. (<ref="Jeremiah 48:23">Jeremiah 48:23</ref>)

H1021.name: Beth-haccherem
H1021.brief: Town in Judah, possibly fortified, mentioned by Jeremiah.
H1021.short: Beth-haccherem was a town in Judah, possibly fortified, mentioned by Jeremiah as a place to raise a signal fire.

H1004H.name: Beth-haggan
H1004H.brief: Place near Jezreel where Ahaziah fled from Jehu.
H1004H.short: Beth-haggan was a place near Jezreel where Ahaziah, king of Judah, fled from Jehu before being killed. (<ref="2Ki.9.27">2Ki.9.27</ref>)

H1027.name: Beth-haram
H1027.brief: Town in Gad, east of the Jordan, fortified by Gad.
H1027.short: Beth-haram (Beth-haran) was a town allotted to the tribe of Gad, east of the Jordan River, which they fortified.

H1031.name: Beth-hoglah
H1031.brief: Town on the border between Judah and Benjamin.
H1031.short: Beth-hoglah was a town on the border between Judah and Benjamin, near the northern end of the Dead Sea. (<ref="Joshua 15:6; 18:19, 21">Joshua 15:6; 18:19, 21</ref>)
H1031.meaning: “house of the partridge” or “place of partridge”

forms.meaning: “house of the partridge” or “place of partridge”

H1032I.name: Beth-horon Lower
H1032I.brief: Town in Ephraim and Dan, site of a famous battle.
H1032I.short: Lower Beth-horon was a town allotted to Ephraim and Dan, known for a battle where the sun stood still. (Multiple references, see article for details)

H1032H.name: Beth-horon Upper
H1032H.brief: Town in Ephraim, near Lower Beth-horon.
H1032H.short: Upper Beth-horon was a town in Ephraim, near Lower Beth-horon, fortified by Solomon.

H1020.name: Beth-jeshimoth
H1020.brief: Town in Moab, allotted to Reuben, mentioned in prophecy.
H1020.short: Beth-jeshimoth was a town in Moab, allotted to Reuben, near where the Israelites camped and mentioned in a prophecy against Moab.

H1034.name: Beth-lebaoth
H1034.brief: Town in Simeon, also called Lebaoth.
H1034.short: Beth-lebaoth was a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon, also known as Lebaoth. (<ref="Joshua 19:6">Joshua 19:6</ref>)

H1035G.name: Bethlehem
H1035G.brief: City of David's birth and Jesus' birth.
H1035G.short: Bethlehem, also called Ephrath or Ephrathah, was the city where David and Jesus were born, located in Judah. (Multiple references, see article for details)

H1035H.name: Bethlehem
H1035H.brief: Town in Zebulun, distinct from Bethlehem in Judah.
H1035H.short: Bethlehem was a town allotted to the tribe of Zebulun, distinct from the more well-known Bethlehem in Judah. (<ref="Joshua 19:15">Joshua 19:15</ref>)

H1023.name: Beth-merhak
H1023.brief: Place near Jerusalem where David stayed during Absalom's revolt.
H1023.short: Beth-merhak was a place near Jerusalem where David stayed with his household during Absalom's revolt. (<ref="2Sa.15.17">2Sa.15.17</ref>)

H1037.name: Beth-millo
H1037.brief: Fortified place in Shechem, associated with Abimelech's rule.
H1037.short: Beth-millo was a fortified place in Shechem where the men of the city made Abimelech king, later becoming his enemies. (<ref="Judges 9:6, 20">Judges 9:6, 20</ref>)
H1037.meaning: “house of Millo” or “house of the rampart”

forms.meaning: “house of Millo” or “house of the rampart”

H1039.name: Beth-nimrah
H1039.brief: Town in Gad, east of the Jordan River.
H1039.short: Beth-nimrah (Nimrah) was a town allotted to the tribe of Gad, east of the Jordan River, which they built or fortified.

H1048.name: Beth-pazzez
H1048.short: Beth-pazzez, a town within the territory allotted to the tribe of Issachar.

H1046.name: Beth-pelet
H1046.brief: Town in southern Judah, resettled after the Babylonian exile.
H1046.short: Beth-pelet was a town in southern Judah, allotted to Judah and later resettled by the people of Judah after the Babylonian exile.

H1047.name: Beth-peor
H1047.brief: Place east of the Jordan, where Moses was buried.
H1047.short: Beth-peor was a place east of the Jordan River, where the Israelites camped and Moses was buried in an unknown valley.

H1050.name: Beth-rehob
H1050.brief: Aramean city and region, allied with Ammon against David.
H1050.short: Beth-rehob (Rehob) was an Aramean city and region, allied with the Ammonites against David, located near the northern border of Israel.

H1052.name: Beth-shean
H1052.brief: City in Manasseh, where Saul's body was displayed.
H1052.short: Beth-shean (Beth-shan) was a city allotted to Manasseh, where the Philistines fastened Saul's body to the wall after his death. (Multiple references, see article for details)

H1053G.name: Beth-shemesh
H1053G.brief: City in Judah, associated with the Ark's return.
H1053G.short: Beth-shemesh was a city allotted to Judah and the Levites, associated with the return of the Ark of the Covenant from the Philistines. (Multiple references, see article for details)

H1053H.name: Beth-shemesh
H1053H.short: Beth-shemesh was a border town in the territory of Issachar. (<ref="Joshua 19:22">Joshua 19:22</ref>)

H1053I.name: Beth-shemesh
H1053I.brief: Fortified city in Naphtali, not conquered by the tribe.
H1053I.short: Beth-shemesh was a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali, from which the Naphtalites did not drive out the Canaanites.

H1029.name: Beth-shittah
H1029.brief: Beth-shittah, place near where Midianites fled from Gideon
H1029.short: Beth-shittah, a location near where the Midianites fled after being defeated by Gideon's army.
H1029.meaning: “house of the acacia tree” or “place of the acacia”

forms.meaning: “house of the acacia tree” or “place of the acacia”

H1054.name: Beth-tappuah
H1054.brief: Town in the hill country of Judah.
H1054.short: Beth-tappuah was a town allotted to Judah, located in the hill country. (<ref="Joshua 15:53">Joshua 15:53</ref>)
H1054.meaning: “house of the apple” of “place of apples”

forms.meaning: “house of the apple” of “place of apples”

H1049.name: Beth-zur
H1049.brief: Town in Judah, fortified by Rehoboam, repaired by Nehemiah.
H1049.short: Beth-zur was a town in the hill country of Judah, fortified by Rehoboam, later repaired by Nehemiah, and associated with Maon.

H1090B.name: Bilhah
H1090B.short: Bilhah was a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon in southern Judah.

H1004K.name: House of the Forest
H1004K.brief: A building in Solomon's palace complex
H1004K.short: The House of the Forest of Lebanon, a building in Solomon's palace.

forms.english: House of the Forest of Lebanon

H1078.name: Bel
H1078.short: Bel, a Babylonian god mentioned in Isaiah 46:1 and <ref="Jeremiah 50:2; 51:44">Jeremiah 50:2; 51:44</ref>), is associated with the god Marduk and is depicted as bowing down and being humiliated by the Lord.
